rules.statement: The Rent Act does not bar a suit on subletting where the premises were sublet before the Act's commencement and the person continues to be a subtenant.
rules.supporting_quote: 1. Section 10(7) of the Rent Act is a bar to a suit on sub letting where the premises had been sublet prior to the date of commencement of the Rent Act (13.1.1972) so long as that person continues, to be a subtenant of the premises so sub-let. The word "that person" in s. 10(7) of the Rent Act mean the sub-tenant and not the tenant. 2. Section 28 of the Rent Act Provides for the ejectment of a tenant of any residential premises who has ceased to occupy same for six months. This section does not apply to business premises as here

rules.statement: The term 'tenant' in the Rent Act refers to the tenant and not the sub-tenant.
